about: A handler naming an action the engine does not have. Same item both sides; core reports it once, as badAction, not again as a schema fault.

core.message: action "explode" is not one the engine runs; use one of set, toggle, push, remove, api, run_source, call_binding, invoke_tool, navigate, toast, emit, open, pin, unpin, flow, branch, confirm, validate, delay, invoke, animate
